subject: Co-sell listing: consolidation of SOC2 / pen-test / DPA for AWS Marketplace
messages:
From: Katherine Jones <katherine.jones@aws-partner.amazon.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cloudcore.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: AWS Marketplace co-sell: evidence needed (SOC2 / pen test / DPA)

Hi Tessa,

Hope you’re well — we’re moving forward with listing Redwood on the AWS Marketplace for the CloudCore co-sell motion and we need to validate the security/compliance artifacts before we can complete the catalog entry. Can you provide the following:

- SOC 2 Type II report or SOC 2 attestation letter
- Third-party penetration test attestation or a letter confirming recent test scope
- Executed DPA (or a DocuSign link we can reference)
- A short index (one-pager) showing where each piece maps to the Marketplace evidence checklist

Ideally we’d get these uploaded into the Marketplace portal by EOD local Friday (10/09). If you have a single consolidated ZIP we can reference for the portal upload that would be preferred. Also let us know if you have any controls/regions notes (data residency) we should flag on the listing.

Thanks — I can loop in the marketplace ops team if you want assistance with the upload.

-Katherine
Katherine Jones
Partner Solutions Architect, AWS Partner Network

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Katherine Jones <katherine.jones@aws-partner.amazon.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 10:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace co-sell: evidence needed (SOC2 / pen test / DPA)

Katherine — thanks for the note and the clear checklist. We can absolutely provide a consolidated evidence package. Proposed plan:

1) We’ll assemble a single ZIP containing a SOC2 attestation letter, the latest independent pen-test attestation, an executed DPA, and a one-page index mapping artifacts to the Marketplace checklist.
2) Legal will prepare a DocuSign envelope for the DPA in case CloudCore prefers to sign electronically.
3) We’ll provide a presigned S3 link and a HubSpot reference so you can link the package in the Marketplace portal.

Attaching an initial index stub and filenames we’ll include. Target: initial upload by EOD Thu 10/07 so you can complete validation ahead of your internal deadlines. If that timeline doesn’t work, tell me and we’ll accelerate.

Attachments: marketplace_evidence_index_20261005.xlsx (stub)

Looping in Lauren for partner coordination and Sergio for commercial context — please advise if we should include any extra audit artifacts.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: action items — AWS Marketplace evidence bundle for CloudCore / Katherine

Team — following Katherine’s request, we need to produce a consolidated evidence bundle and upload it for the Marketplace listing. Assignments below (EOD Thu 10/07 unless noted):

- Aditya: pull the signed SOC 2 Type II letter and the most recent third-party pen-test attestation. Confirm scope/dates and redaction requirements. Filename we’ll use: redwood_SOC2_type2_letter_2026.pdf and thirdparty_pen_test_attestation_2026.pdf
- Laura (Legal): prepare DocuSign envelope for the DPA and send exec copy to procurement@cloudcore.com. If CloudCore wants a paper-signed copy, coordinate with Procurement. Filename expected: redwood_dpa_executed.docx
- Priyom: assemble marketplace_evidence_index_20261005.xlsx and create evidence_package_20261007.zip containing all PDFs and the index. Upload to our S3 bucket (pre-signed link) and share the link here and in HubSpot.
- Sergio: own partner communication cadence — confirm with Katherine the portal upload URL and any naming conventions required by AWS Ops. Also confirm whether CloudCore requires any additional region flags for EU data handling (they indicated US but confirm).

Notes: if any artifact requires redaction, mark that clearly in the index and add an unredacted copy to the legal-only folder. If we hit delays, call out ASAP and we’ll ask for a 48-hour extension from AWS.

Quoted for context: "Can you provide SOC2 Type II, pen test attestation, executed DPA, and index for portal upload" — Katherine (AWS)

Thanks — Tessa

From: Katherine Jones <katherine.jones@aws-partner.amazon.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cloudcore.com
Date: Thu, 07 Oct 2026 19:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace co-sell: evidence needed (SOC2 / pen test / DPA)

Tessa / Team — thanks for the quick turnaround. I’ve received the presigned link and the evidence package (evidence_package_20261007.zip). Quick confirmation:

- SOC2 attestation present and dated 2026 — good.
- Pen test attestation received — scope looks acceptable to Marketplace Ops.
- DPA executed — procurement@cloudcore.com has confirmed receipt and e-signature.
- Index maps artifacts to Marketplace checklist cleanly — appreciated.

Next steps: I’ll push the artifacts into the AWS Marketplace portal and run validation checks. If all passes, we’ll mark the listing as ready for co-sell enablement; expected finalization target is Mon 10/18. I’ll keep you updated if Ops needs further detail during validation.

Thanks — appreciate the speed.

-Katherine
